mechanism_decision_rules.forcing_feedback_cancellation: cos(b,R)<=-0.9 and both ||b|| and ||R|| >= ||delta|| on at least 50% of steps
mechanism_decision_rules.persistent_forcing_accumulation: R/b <= 0.25 on at least 80% of steps
mechanism_decision_rules.persistent_state_feedback_dominance: in the last quarter R>b on at least 75% of steps, median R/b>1, median cos(R,Delta_next)>=0.8, and late median R/b exceeds early median; this is a propagation/persistence label, not a stronger expansion claim

pre_transition_propagation_interpretatio.G_approximately_1_and_alignment_approxim: state persistence is the main observed propagation component
pre_transition_propagation_interpretatio.G_gt_1_and_alignment_approximately_1: possible same-direction expansion, subject to the stronger causal claim gate
pre_transition_propagation_interpretatio.low_alignment: rotation or complex deformation rather than simple same-direction expansion
